items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Chick Chambers, yes. I remember him, yes.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember a trumpet player, or a corner player called Joe Johnson, do you know? No, I don't remember a trumpet player. Or Chick Chambers, or?
Chick Chambers, yes. I remember him, yes.
What sort of trumpet player was he? He was all right. He was a head man to him. Sugar Johnny, was he the same?
